Name: Seasonal Hats
Author: paradigmnomad
Description:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/vml9Sqa.png[/img]

[img]https://imgur.com/asuQXFm.png[/img]
This adds four seasonal hats:
[list]
[*]Deer Antlers;
[*]Mossy Flower Crown Elk Antlers;
[*]Flower Crown;
[*]and Unicorn Flower Crown.
[/list]
These are new hats, they don't replace any vanilla hats (so they're fully compatible with other mods).

You can...
[list]
[*] buy them from the hat mouse for 1000g;
[*]or spawn them with mods like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url];
[*]or use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]'s hand mirror.
[/list]
The hats change automatically for each season. If you prefer the version for a specific season, you can use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to enable fixed-season hats like "Deer Antlers (Spring)". This will add them to both shops and Fashion Sense.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/kLbxt2U.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400/]SMAPI﻿[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Unzip the download into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png[/img]﻿
Just delete the mod from [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font]. Any custom hats in your save will safely turn into "Error Item" hats, so you won't break your save.
